descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S09 Nursing Home ledger rules: today's line state × action → result

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Re-completing a note (Regenerate) never creates a second entry. (TFA-92589 AC 3; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)
  • U5 Nursing Home: a same-day revisit appends rather than overwriting the earlier visit's entry (PR #52). (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Resident ledgers seeded per cell (spec fixtures), model calls mocked

When Per cell: a new Pre-Round after a finished visit; Generate on a visit's pre-round line; Regenerate without a new Pre-Round; Generate on a legacy unnumbered pre-round line; Save Note twice before Generate; a hand-typed unnumbered line before the next Pre-Round

Then Visit 1 finished + new Pre-Round → 'Visit 2 · today' appended beneath Visit 1. Visit 2 pre-round line + Generate → Visit 2 finished, Visit 1 unchanged. Visit 2 finished + Regenerate → Visit 2 repaired in place, no Visit 3. Legacy unnumbered pre-round line + Generate → one line for today. Visit 2 pre-round line + Save Note again → still Visit 2, one line. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions per cell (exact stored ledger). The Hospital cells are S01 (pending → finished), S04 (none → appended) and S11 (Regenerate, pre-round re-save). The legacy cell's unnumbered result is not evidence for U4 (Q10). Cells 1–3 follow Quinn's reading of Q1 (a new Pre-Round after the note = revisit, a new numbered line; …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S09

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-11.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — finishing a nursing-home note replaces today's pre-round line with the dated entry — expected
  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — a same-day nursing-home revisit starts at Pre-Round: it appends the next visit, and finishing it keeps the first — expected
  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — regenerating a nursing-home note repairs today's line instead of adding a visit — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's specs in e2e/course-timeline.spec.ts plus our cells not written yet): per-cell ledgers seeded through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key on fresh @roundai.test accounts, model calls mocked (mockNoteFinish); dev has no admin key, one shared account and no action mock, so…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
